messages:
alice-sales: Heads-up: NovaBank procurement pushed back. They want an 8-week POC showing EU+APAC data residency, explicit NO-US-control-plane, and a short-term reserved quote (month-to-month ok). Call in 30m. Can we confirm technical constraints?
tom-solutions: Key asks from presales brief: 1) ingress+egress stays in eu or ap regions, 2) control plane endpoints must be local-only (no signalling to us regions), 3) BYOK with customer HSM in EU, 4) list of subprocessors for those regions and whether any logs/metrics leave region.
rachel-eng: Quick reality check: our Hosted API has endpoints in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1, but control-plane metadata and billing aggregation currently flow to central us-east for correlation. We have a local-only control-plane mode in Private/Dedicated. For Hosted, we can attempt to suppress metric forwarding but it requires an infra-change flag and a canary deploy. ETA ~10 business days.
paul-legal: NovaBank also asked for the subprocessor inventory plus evidence (SOC2 + regional attestation) for each vendor touching metadata. I'll prepare the subproc list for eu-west/ap-southeast and note which vendors store logs.
anita-privacy: They insist no metadata or telemetry that could identify customers leave the territory. BYOK requirements: customer holds key in HSM; wrapped key uploaded to our connector; unwrapping must occur only inside region. We need to show sequence diagram and an attestation statement.
devops-bot: @channel POC ticket created: https://redwood.internal/poc/1799988888 70 includes network template, attestation checklist, and short-term pricing worksheet.
tom-solutions: For pricing — propose two lines: (1) Dedicated ephemeral pool in eu+ap reserved for 8 weeks (monthly invoice, cancel at term) with setup fee. (2) Hosted geo-pin with fallback to us (cheaper) but flags non-compliant for strict residency. Procurement likely wants (1).
rachel-eng: To be explicit for the docs, recommend the following config snippet as the POC control plane contract: `control_plane_mode: "private-managed"
control_plane_endpoints: ["eu-west-1", "ap-southeast-1"]
metric_forwarding: false
routing_fallback: "disabled"`
paul-legal: Also flag DPA clause: we can commit subprocessors and region residency for POC duration but need a negotiating amendment for longer-term contract. I'll attach the amendment template.
anita-privacy: Also note impact: disabling routing_fallback increases risk of regional outage. We should document availability tradeoffs (SLOs during POC).
devops-bot: Attached: poc-network-sketch.png, subproc-inventory-eu-ap.pdf, provisional-invoice.xlsx
alice-sales: Action items before call: @rachel-eng confirm 10-business-day infra ETA and whether we can accelerate; @paul-legal attach SOC2 & subproc attestation; @tom-solutions prepare short-term cost bullets; @anita-privacy prepare BYOK sequence diagram.
tom-solutions: I'll include an option table on the call: "Dedicated local control plane (compliant)" vs "Hosted geo-pin (non-compliant but quicker)", with costs and lead times.
rachel-eng: If customer insists on zero telemetry leaving region we should push Dedicated Private with VPC peering and HSM gateway. We can run a short pilot with reduced monitoring to keep logs on-region.
alice-sales: Great, thanks everyone. If we can get SOC2 + attestation + a one-month invoice option, procurement will likely sign the POC. See you on the call.
